    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # spaced every 7 cells, with 3x3 interiors). The most frequent payload
    # is the ordinary tile color; other marker colors connect when repeated
    # on a shared row or column, with all intervening background gaps filled.
    rs = list(range(2, h, 7))
    cs = list(range(2, w, 7))
    from collections import Counter
    vals = [grid[r][c] for r in rs for c in cs]
    common = Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts = [(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in rs for c in cs

    for i,(r,c,v) in enumerate(pts):
